content: ora2pg does regex/pattern-based mechanical substitution (NVL->COALESCE, SYSDATE->clock_timestamp, etc.), not semantic translation. Known weak spots: dynamic SQL (EXECUTE IMMEDIATE/DBMS_SQL) cannot be statically resolved reliably; Oracle packages have no PG equivalent (ora2pg emulates via schemas or name-prefixing, losing package-level global/session state); nested/local functions inside PL/SQL blocks must be hoisted to standalone functions; empty string vs NULL handling differs; ora2pg vendor claims ~70% auto-conversion rate for real codebases, remainder needs manual rewrite.
